scope: Existing catalog extended with per-condition source, witness, actual implementation and open calibration. No generator, evaluator, acceptance or P21-P25 implementation changes.

semantics.PASS: Conditional future criterion-level result only when every applicable necessary subcondition has fresh same-model evidence, a valid scenario/profile and no mandatory correction; this catalog grants no PASS.
semantics.FAIL: A demonstrated violation of a known necessary condition. Keep other unresolved findings; do not erase them because FAIL dominates.
semantics.UNKNOWN: No demonstrated violation, but at least one necessary condition lacks effective profile, evidence, coverage or resolved interpretation.
semantics.missing_rule: Required predicate or applicability genuinely unspecified; absence of checker is not missing rule.
semantics.missing_profile: Qualitative rule exists, but effective scenario/anthropometric/operation/quality calibration is unqualified.
semantics.missing_evidence: Predicate known but current model lacks valid measurement, route, use or counterfactual witness.
semantics.delivery: FAIL and effective UNKNOWN block design-option display/count/delivery. Diagnostic evidence is not a design option. One criterion PASS never implies whole-model acceptance.

global_constraints: No invented numeric thresholds, weights, area caps or ergonomic calibration.
Source body width .7m and source fixture bundles are bounded study profiles, not comprehensive ergonomic approval.
Do not transfer evidence across changed geometry, profiles, programmes, or report hashes.
Daylight/ventilation sufficiency and stair/lift engineering are POST_MVP/NOT_EVALUATED; conceptual core presence/access remains.
Catalog current_state=UNKNOWN is a non-assessment marker, not a replacement for runtime FAIL/UNKNOWN. This inventory assesses no plan.
The source four-layer activity model is body/object, door, human body and route with real operation cycle; installation and simultaneous use remain accompanying requirements.

criteria.paraphrase: Choose a source-supported usable programme from net geometry while preserving n, necessary bedrooms and all services. Try genuine core/split/placement alternatives before reducing bedrooms. Approved one-bedroom/two-person and two-bedroom/four-person design scenarios are not actual population, solver feasibility, or automatic quality approval. Do not maximize bedroom count or let mean quality hide one poor unit.
required_data: Public request and exact n; per-unit net floor/wall/common/core accounting with conventions.
Programme ID/approval provenance, per-unit sleep roles and design capacity; actual fixture dimensions and distinct instances, clothes and activities.
Source-supported lower-bound/profile inventory; log absent prefilter bounds separately from impossible geometry.
AP07 attempted alternatives, unchanged programme constraints, budgets and explicit untried branches; reduction creates a new programme alternative, not fixed-programme repair.
Fresh placement/access/operation findings and calibrated room/unit quality-floor evidence; Pareto vectors with same references, no hidden weighted score.
criteria.conditional_pass: All necessary programme and bundle uses proven for each unit under qualified applicable profiles, fixed n and auditable alternative selection; quality floors and non-dominated selection supported. Not executable closure in current study.
fail_examples: Silently lower n or sleeping capacity to fit.

Average quality compensates for a proven failed unit.
missing_rule: Operational selection of required quality dimensions and reviewed acceptance-anchor criteria remains unresolved; the qualitative programme requirement itself exists.
missing_profile: Calibrated quality floors and reviewed scenario/equipment/activity profiles.
missing_evidence: Same-model full-bundle adequacy, AP07 comparative sequence, genuine net-capacity/prefilter and alternative-selection evidence.

condition_result_vocabulary.PASS_SCOPED: Only the explicitly witnessed subcondition and profile; not aggregate PASS.
condition_result_vocabulary.FAIL_SCOPED: Demonstrated violation of the applicable necessary subcondition; unresolved findings retained.
condition_result_vocabulary.INDETERMINATE: Available evidence does not settle the condition.
condition_result_vocabulary.CONFLICT: Source/evidence conflict remains distinct from a proven architectural violation.
condition_result_vocabulary.EVALUATION_ERROR: Execution/evaluation error, not proof of infeasible geometry.
condition_result_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: Requires an explicit applicability reason; not silently PASS.
